title: fix(components): avatar pictures keep their proportions instead of being stretched
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Ca5yCeCT8dXDvSsj3xKvAJ)_

Fixes #36610

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户和组织的头像图片不是正方形时，不再被压扁或拉长塞进圆圈，而是保持原比例、裁掉多出的部分；正方形图片看起来和以前一样。
- 属于界面体验区的缺陷修复，来自你发现的「头像被压缩变形」问题。
- 出错的话只是头像边缘被多裁一点，不影响任何数据，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The shared `AvatarImage` (`ui/packages/components/src/ui/avatar.tsx`) set `aspect-square h-full w-full` and no `object-fit`, so every call site that passed no class drew with the browser default `fill`, which scales each axis on its own: a 400×200 photo became a squashed oval in the circle.

- `AvatarImage` now carries `object-cover` in its default classes: the picture fills the avatar, keeps its proportions and the overflow is cropped. `cn` is `twMerge`, so a caller's `object-contain` (the record-header logo path in `containers.tsx`) replaces it rather than stacking.
- Dropped the two local `className="object-cover"` patches that the default now covers: `plugin-detail/src/CommentAuthorAvatar.tsx` and `app-shell/src/console/organizations/manage/SettingsPage.tsx`.
- The record-header picture keeps its explicit cover/contain split; untouched.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

No new prop, no export change.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/avatar-image-object-fit-36610.test.tsx` (images reported as loaded so Radix draws the `img`): no class ⇒ `object-cover`; `object-contain` passed ⇒ `object-contain` and no `object-cover`; an unrelated class keeps the default.
- Reverse verification (fix committed first, the default class removed on disk, test run, restored from `HEAD`, blob hash equal to `HEAD`'s): the two default-class tests fail without the fix, the `object-contain` pin passes both ways, as it should.
- `snapshot-critical.test.tsx` (Avatar snapshots) and `page-header-record-picture-11383.test.tsx` (the cover/contain record picture) pass unchanged: 3 files, 36 tests.

## Acceptance notes

- Not re-shot in the running console: the before/after frame below renders the real `Avatar`/`AvatarImage` from this branch's source with Tailwind compiled from it, next to the pre-fix class string, in Chromium. The card's live re-check (account menu, members page, user field) is the two-minute check below.
- Out of scope, as the card says: a square-crop step on avatar upload.

## Verification

Chromium, a 400×200 picture in avatars of 20, 32, 40 and 64 px, plus a 64 px rounded square passing `object-contain`. Computed `object-fit` read from each `img`: before `fill` ×4 and `contain` ×1; after `cover` ×4 and `contain` ×1. Before, the face is a vertical oval in every circle; after, it is round and the sides are cropped. The `object-contain` logo is identical before and after. (Frame attached in the project thread; GitHub's image store takes browser uploads only.)

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/components/src/ui/avatar.tsx`: the one default-class change.
2. `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/avatar-image-object-fit-36610.test.tsx`: the override pin.

Two-minute check: set a non-square picture (e.g. 400×200) as your user image and open the account menu: the face keeps its proportions, cropped to the circle.
